errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email and password don't match. Check them and try again.

errors.USER_EXISTS: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in instead.

errors.NETWORK_OFFLINE: You're offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to this.
errors.INVALID_STATE: This action isn't available right now. Refresh and try again.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Some information is missing or invalid. Check it and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find that document. It may have been deleted.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
